_readme: Curated current pricing per tracked tool. `verified` is the date every row was read on the vendor's page. confidence: verified = plan name and price read together on the page; page-figure = the figure is on the page but the plan mapping is the reader's; not-published = the page shows no price. The weekly pricing watch flags changes; the monthly asset refresh re-curates and appends to changelog. A watch diff is not a price change: pages with a monthly/annual toggle (Activepieces, Make) render whichever set is default, so read both states in the browser before writing a changelog line. Never write 'credits' for Gravity's own row.
note: Where a vendor prices in euros the figure is kept in euros. Per-seat prices are marked. Tools whose page shows no figure are listed as not published rather than guessed. Lindy's row was re-read on 10 October 2026.

tools.name: Zapier
tools.free: Yes, 100 tasks a month on two-step Zaps
tools.unit: Tasks: one per step, more for AI steps

tools.name: Make
tools.free: Yes, 1,000 credits a month, 15-minute minimum interval
tools.starting: $12 a month for 10,000 credits (Core, annual billing; $16 monthly; US list re-read 13 Nov 2026, the $9 Make Plan is the India and Australia list)
tools.included: 10,000 credits; Pro, Teams and Enterprise above

tools.name: n8n
tools.free: None on n8n Cloud (trial); self-hosting is free
tools.unit: Executions: one per full workflow run, any step count

tools.name: Activepieces
tools.starting: $16 a month (Plus, yearly billing; $20 on monthly billing)
tools.unit: Credits: one per run, $0.007 each beyond the plan
tools.included: 10,000 credits; Team $166 yearly ($200 monthly); Embed from $36k a year

tools.name: Pipedream
tools.free: Yes, $0 plan for building and testing (development only, no production environment)
tools.starting: $99 a month (Startup, annual billing; $150 billed monthly)
tools.unit: Usage credits ($0.012 each beyond the plan) and external users ($2 each beyond the plan)
tools.included: Startup: production environment, 10,000 usage credits and 100 external users; Business is custom with volume pricing

tools.name: Gumloop
tools.unit: Credits at the list cost of each task's tokens, compute and tool calls; 8% orchestration fee on that cost, 16% with your own model keys

tools.name: Lindy
tools.free: Trial only: $50 in free credits for 7 days, no card
tools.starting: $49.99 per seat a month (Team, 5,000 credits; the only version served on 13 Nov 2026, though some loads between 10 and 27 Oct got a $29.99 version for 3,000 credits)
tools.unit: Credits per task: 2 to 250 for an everyday ask, up to 1,000 for a research report
tools.included: Team: 5,000 credits a month at $49.99 per user; a credit dropdown runs up to 1,750,000 for $9,999.50; top-ups $10 per 1,000 credits

tools.name: Relevance AI
tools.starting: Not published on the pricing page (sign-in or contact)
tools.unit: Credits per action (per the product docs)

tools.name: Voiceflow
tools.starting: Not published on the pricing page (contact sales)
tools.unit: Per agent and per seat (per the product docs)

tools.name: Botpress
tools.free: Yes, Free: 100 conversations a month, 3 seats, 3 AI agents, no top-ups
tools.unit: Conversations a month, plus AI usage (each conversation includes $0.10 of AI usage)
tools.included: Plus: 250 conversations a month and $25 of AI usage, extra packs of 100 for $65; Team $750 a month billed annually: 1,500 conversations and $150 of AI usage, packs of 100 for $50; storage add-on $40 a month; Enterprise custom

tools.name: Stack AI
tools.free: Yes, $0: 500 runs a month, 2 projects, 1 seat
tools.starting: Paid tiers not shown with a figure on the page

tools.name: Dify
tools.starting: $590 a year per workspace (Professional: 5,000 message credits a month, 3 team members)
tools.included: Team $1,590 a year per workspace: 10,000 message credits a month, 50 team members; Enterprise on request

tools.name: Vellum
tools.free: Not shown as a plan on the page
tools.starting: $30 a month (first paid tier on the page)
tools.included: Tiers at $30, $100 and $200 a month on the page

tools.name: Taskade
tools.free: Yes, Free: no monthly AI credits
tools.starting: $6 a month (Starter, yearly billing: $72 a year for 3 users, 10,000 AI credits a month)
tools.unit: AI credits a month shared by the plan's users; auto top-up on every paid plan
tools.included: Pro $10 a month (10 users, 50,000 credits), Business $25 (unlimited users, 150,000), Max $100 (400,000), all on yearly billing; Enterprise is quote-only from 22 September 2026

tools.name: Bardeen
tools.starting: Not published on the pricing page as read
tools.unit: Credits per action (per the product docs)

tools.name: Gravity
tools.free: Yes, Free at $0 with no card
tools.starting: $15 a month (Mini Pilot); Free at $0 with no card; Auto Pilot $20 a month; Auto Pilot Max $100 a month; public beta, no waitlist
tools.unit: Monthly subscription with usage included; buy more usage if you run out
tools.included: Free: no card, no automated agents. Mini Pilot: one automated agent. Auto Pilot: unlimited automated agents. Auto Pilot Max: the most usage

changelog.change: added a Starter plan at $6 a month on yearly billing ($72 a year for 3 users, 10,000 AI credits a month) below Pro at $10, so the cheapest paid plan fell from $10 to $6 a month; Pro, Business and Max are unchanged at $10, $25 and $100, per our 3 November snapshot and a re-read on 13 November

replaced its $29, $49 and $99 a month tiers with Free for development, Startup at $99 a month on annual billing ($150 monthly) with 10,000 usage credits and 100 external users included, and a custom Business plan; first seen in our 6 October snapshot (our 15 September read still showed the old tiers) and re-read on 13 November

the scripted read again saw the $29.99 Team version (3,000 credits) while a browser load of the pricing page showed $49.99 a month for 5,000 credits each, top-ups $10 per 1,000 credits, so the page serves both versions to different loads, as on 10 October; the starting price a browser visitor sees is unchanged, per our 27 October snapshot

the $29.99 Team version and its 3,000-credit tier no longer appear anywhere on the page; Team is $49.99 per user a month for 5,000 credits, top-ups $10 per 1,000 credits (starting price unchanged from 13 Oct), per our 22 October snapshot

the $5, $20 and $50 top-up packs are no longer listed; the page now describes auto top-up of up to $1,000 at a time, and shows yearly totals ($120, $300, $1,200, $3,000) under the $10, $25, $100 and $250 monthly-equivalent prices, per our 22 October snapshot

the page served one Team card on both the scripted read and a browser load: $49.99 a month per user for 5,000 credits, with Free ($50 in credits, 7 days) and Enterprise; the $29.99 for 3,000 credits version seen on 10 October was not served

the Plus, Pro and Max plan names are gone from the page; one paid card, Team, served two versions across 13 loads: $29.99 for 3,000 credits per user, or $49.99 with a credit dropdown defaulting to 5,000. The former $99.99 (15,000) and $199.99 (35,000) price points now sit as dropdown steps on the Team card

free trial restated as $50 in free credits that last 7 days with no card; paid plans unchanged at $29.99, $99.99 and $199.99 a month per user (3,000, 15,000 and 35,000 credits). The pricing page now labels the paid tier Team rather than Plus and lists Free, Team and Enterprise cards

Enterprise lost its published price: the card read $250 a month with a self-serve Get Enterprise button on 1 September 2026 and now reads Custom with a Contact sales button. Free, Pro, Business and Max are unchanged at $0, $10, $25 and $100 a month on annual billing. The page's own Offer structured data still carried the old $250 a month ($3,000 a year) figure when we checked
closed for paying customers (free accounts ended 15 August 2026); no longer tracked
the page's plan-price set moved from $13/$33/$66 style annual figures to $13.33/$19.99/$33.33 style figures (monthly-equivalent display), per our July snapshot
annual-billing figures ($13, $33, $66 a month) appeared next to the monthly ones on the page, per our October 2025 snapshot
a €60 figure joined the page's plan set alongside €20, €24 and €50, per our April 2025 snapshot
the page's plan set changed to $0, $25 and $150 a month, per our July 2025 snapshot; by September 2026 Plus is $16 a month yearly with a per-credit overage
